title: Write the field repository into a form
summary: Brings the persistent fields of a text DFM, and their declarations in its unit, in line with the field repository as a change set, dry run by default
intro: Read this when a form should follow the field repository. drag-lint repo write-dfm prints the property changes of existing persistent fields and, for a field selection, the fields to add or remove; --apply or --select writes them with a backup, and a --select file must hold the plan id of the dry run its ids are from. Every byte outside a planned change stays the same, the new text is checked by Delphi's own reader before it is written, and a binary DFM is refused.

questions.ask: How do I bring the fields of a form in line with the repository?
How do I add every repository field of a table to a dataset as persistent fields?
